scope: paper-polish methods integrated into existing forge text editing; no new skill or stage change.

static_checks.scope_note: Deterministic source and document checks; no model-quality or reader-acceptance claim.

existing_prose_checker_tests.scope: Unchanged deterministic expression-checker regression; not a semantic-quality score.

forward_test.method: Two independent agents, one baseline and one candidate, processed the same four raw requests in isolated directories. No expected answer or earlier conclusions were given. Parent model inherited; one execution per variant and case.

cases.observed: Seven paragraphs, the core judgement, the two-product boundary and rhetorical question were retained. Sentence edits stayed within the original propositions.

Date, sample counts, version, error-budget upper bound, status identifiers, uncertainty, causality and customer-acceptance boundaries were retained in the edited body. Original language and paragraph format retained.

Baseline narrowed the conclusion in its delivered body after disclosing the change. Candidate retained the original claim and separated the narrower candidate with original, suggestion, reason and risk.
Readable prose was completed. The formula placeholder stayed in position and the unprocessed formula was explicitly reported.

forward_test.manual_semantic_comparison: Root inspected all eight actual replies, not just the agents run notes.

review.scope: Seven selected existing-file changes and the new paper-polish reference; isolated baseline and candidate; all eight actual text replies.
limits: Four short text cases; not cross-model, long-document chunking or actual-author acceptance.
Four cases with one execution each; not a general quality ranking or latency/token measurement.
No cross-model comparison, host discovery E2E or real-author acceptance.
Private source and complete replies remain outside the public repository.
Long-document chunking is defined in the rule but was not exercised by the four short-text replays.
